title: UniFi community release index
description: Releases announced on https://community.ui.com, grouped by product family. Written by 'refresh.sh' from the 'releases()' query in 'releases.graphql', reshaped by 'shape.jq'.
markdownDescription: Releases announced on [community.ui.com](https://community.ui.com), grouped by product family. Written by `refresh.sh` from the `releases()` query in `releases.graphql`, reshaped by `shape.jq`.

propertyNames.description: Product family: the release slug with its version stripped off the end, as in 'UniFi-OS-Dream-Machines' or 'UniFi-OS-Express-7'.
propertyNames.markdownDescription: Product family: the release slug with its version stripped off the end, as in `UniFi-OS-Dream-Machines` or `UniFi-OS-Express-7`.

additionalProperties.description: Every release of that family the index holds, newest version first, one entry per version and stage.

version.description: Version as the API reports it, verbatim. Mobile apps append a store build number in brackets, as in '3.8.2 (655)'.
version.markdownDescription: Version as the API reports it, verbatim. Mobile apps append a store build number in brackets, as in `3.8.2 (655)`.

stage.description:
'GA' is generally available and 'RC' a release candidate.  
'T' is all but invisible without a signed-in session that has release-testing access, and is where the '6.0.x' releases sit.  
'U' appears on 13 releases in the whole catalogue.  

The API expands neither letter: 'ReleaseStage' has no label field and introspection is disabled.

id.description: Argument to the 'release(id:)' query in 'release.graphql', which returns the per-board download links.
